description: Source code for a Flutter-based personal notes application. It includes app initialization, theme management, local database operations using SQLite, state management for notes, and UI screens for listing, viewing, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: ThemeProvider
classes.description: Manages the app's theme mode (system, light, dark), persists the preference using SharedPreferences, and notifies listeners on change.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Handles local database operations with SQLite, including creating the database, querying, inserting, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model class representing a note with id, title, content, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class providing access to notes list, loading, saving, and deleting notes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter bindings and runs the app widget.

methods.name: _initTheme
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches stored theme mode setting and initializes theme mode.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Updates theme mode and persists the setting.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes with optional search query.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
